verdict.rationale: Adyen's platforms docs explicitly cover the full marketplace workflow: onboarding and verifying sellers (adyen-docs-11), splitting payments and holding funds until payout (adyen-docs-21), configurable payout frequency and multi-currency payouts (adyen-docs-12, adyen-docs-22), and fast/local payout options (adyen-docs-9, adyen-docs-13). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer reports specifically validating the Adyen for Platforms onboarding/split/payout flow (community evidence discusses general Adyen integration complexity but not this specific feature set).
